proposal.summary: Front right wheel squeaking with motor overcurrent error E-MOT-12

draft_ticket.title: Investigate front right wheel squeaking and E-MOT-12 error
draft_ticket.description: The robot reported strong squeaking from the front right wheel and slowed during turns. Telemetry shows error code E-MOT-12, which the manual identifies as a drive motor overcurrent. The manual also notes that wheel squeaking often indicates debris in the caster or a worn wheel bearing. A physical inspection of the front right wheel and motor should be performed to determine if debris or bearing wear is causing the overcurrent and squeaking. Battery and network status appear normal (64 % battery, network online).

extracted_facts.claim: Front right wheel squeaking and robot slows in turns

proposal.summary: Arm vibration observed during lifting; telemetry shows no errors; manual indicates possible loose mount or worn bearing.

draft_ticket.title: Arm vibration during lifting – investigate mechanical cause
draft_ticket.description: The operator reports that the arm vibrates when lifting. Telemetry indicates no error codes and the battery is healthy. The ARM‑6 manual identifies loose gripper mounts or worn joint bearings as typical causes of such vibration. No sensor or motor current data is available to confirm the exact source. Further inspection of the gripper mount and joint bearings is recommended before the next shift.
